dedup: revised question/passage256/(question,original answer) components; no bare-answer edges; old PopQA same-question OR subject phrase>=4+original gold match
primary_method: Unified ActiveBlock-All; binary frozen gate, eta0, all-query hard attention block for all routes1 or3; no explicit refusal

tracks.zero_shot: unchanged PopQA weights/costs/thresholds/temperatures, source-frozen CAST and ContextFocus; primary generalization track
tracks.calibrated: new independent NQ calibration/validation PCA32 Logistic C1 at same early layer; new artifacts only; supporting adaptation track with disclosed data advantage over source-frozen baselines

trajectory_reuse: identical same-layer Vanilla and unconditional All-Hard trajectories feed both gate routings; a second probe adds zero blind generation branches
replay_limitation: cache-composed quality is not an automatic-path timing/call verification; technical automatic checks must be measured separately
calibrated_probe_fit: source-protocol PCA32 Logistic C1 on calibration only; policy grid param_cost[1,2,4,8],abstain_cost[.5,1,2],param_threshold[.2,.35,.5],abstain_threshold[.2,.35,.5]; Active route1 union route3; validation Macro with ext-drop<=1pp then H, lexicographic policy ties
calibrated_temperature: five fact-grouped validation folds, candidate temperatures [.25,.5,1,2,4,8]; utility-token-proxy confidence; no blind fit
gatekeeping: fixed sequence of four families: formal alpha opens only if every hypothesis of the previous family rejects; show all raw/adjusted p values but mark unopened families descriptive
guardrail: ext paired factual-accuracy difference vs Vanilla: one-sided 95% lower bound >= -0.01; missing or wide interval is inconclusive, not passed
unit: locked independent fact/component, both contexts paired; labels model-specific from offline Closed-Book; no enrichment after seeing SLEA
statistics: 10000 fact-group paired bootstrap replicates and paired fact-wise swap randomization; fixed seed42; two-sided p=(b+1)/(B+1); four-state missing denominator -> non-estimable
cb_prior: p_CB measured on all un-enriched calibration+validation facts before blind generation; blind prior also reported separately, never silently substituted
factual_target: original NQ answer for ext/param/align utility; abstain utility is refusal when CB wrong and context counterfactual; original benchmark swapped-answer faithfulness reported separately
quality_budget: 32 new tokens or EOS for all new-dataset branches; 512 input tokens, no truncation; old PopQA supplement stays12
top10: first token vocabulary top10 IDs and raw logits captured in ordinary forward; for CAD distinguish raw branches and effective combined distribution
performance: fixed8 inputs, 2 per state, 3 repetitions, 12tokens, warmup/sync/rotating order; measure actual automatic active paths separately from cached replay; report active counts/calls/KV
source_fidelity: NQ natural questions/passages with synthetic entity substitutions; CAST task adaptation and ContextFocus prefill boundary adaptation disclosed
cast_comparator: source-validation strongest among original frozen canonical CAST and 18 high-alpha/single/multi diagnostics; frozen before ANY NQ generation; StepB blind tables unchanged

source_diagnostic_grid.multi: per-layer calibrated behavior directions from l* through final residual, condition at l* only

source_cast_selection: Macro then H on source validation; exact tie keeps canonical; new variants tie-break lower alpha, layer, lexical variant

matched_timing.optional_method: cast_strong, if distinct from StepB canonical
matched_timing.warmup: one ext and one param for each method
matched_timing.scope: same job, synchronized end-to-end generation incl policy/encoder; shared resident modules; hook registration/static setup excluded

local_environment_addition: duckdb1.2.2 isolated .cache reader only; frozen model dependencies unchanged
